_doc: F4: sustained 100 msg/s on a known topic. In practice $BROKER's default VPN sees much more traffic because F5 publishes 100 msg/s and F6 floods at 3000 msg/s into the same VPN. Range widened accordingly — assertion is now 'the model reports a positive rate in a sensible operational range', not 'F4's contribution in isolation'. The narrower F4-only test belongs at the tool layer, not the LLM layer.
prompt: How fast is $BROKER receiving messages right now?
